copy.tagline: 评估功能投资的价值，辅助决策是否值得投入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要判断功能投资的回报和战略意义
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate feature investments to decide whether to invest

howto.what: 该技能指导产品经理评估功能投资的财务影响，包括收入关联、成本结构、ROI和战略价值，最后给出建设或不建设的建议。
howto.when: 当产品经理需要基于财务数据决定是否构建一个功能时触发，尤其适用于功能开发成本超过1工程师月或需要向利益相关者证明优先级时。

say.text: 评估SSO对中端市场客户的财务影响
say.note: 技能会计算收入、成本、ROI和战略价值。

say.text: 分析AI助手功能的投资回报率
say.note: 技能会进行财务建模并给出建议。

howto.what_en: This skill guides product managers through evaluating feature investments using financial impact analysis, including revenue connection, cost structure, ROI, and strategic value, delivering build/don't build recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a product manager needs a data-driven decision on whether to build a feature, especially if it costs more than 1 engineer-month or requires stakeholder justification.

say_en.text: Evaluate the financial impact of SSO for mid-market customers
say_en.note: The skill calculates revenue, costs, ROI, and strategic value.

say_en.text: Analyze the ROI of an AI assistant feature
say_en.note: The skill performs financial modeling and gives recommendations.
